scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. All 70 live decisions (every turn-start and replan frame) of turns 58-83 of live Deity Kongo civvis-20261118T045850Z (Science lane, 6 players, Continents, Online; at peace with every major all game; the deterrent's neighbour on these frames is Canada at 1.03-1.92 times our power on 29 of the off arm's 33 deterrent frames and the Aztec at 1.03-1.05 on 4, t76-77). Each case is the exact prefix of events.jsonl the live decider had read when it answered (the run's own input capture, checked byte for byte against the log), queried with --turn T --resumed on one ci-profile civvis_orders built from this branch at 13db5058a0. Both arms carry the 587 tags the live brain passed as --with, the Science lane and CIVILIZATION_KONGO; the on arm adds the gene. The off arm's genome equals the live why.log genome on all 70 frames, its production orders equal the live decider's on 33 of 70 frames (21 of the 26 turn-start frames), and the deterrent it trains is one the live journal trained that turn on 28 of its 33 deterrent frames. Each frame replays the live board, so the frames are independent proposals, not a played on-arm game. Off, the deterrent is trained on 33 frames (18 Warrior, 14 Archer, 1 Horseman), 17 of them at a board income below zero. On, it is trained on 14 (9 Warrior, 5 Archer): 12 at an income of zero or more, identical to the off arm, and 2 at -1.0 (t68 and t69 turn start), where the plan reads the capital under threat from barbarians and the gate stands down by design. Orders differ on 19 frames, t60-t78; from t70 on the on arm trains no deterrent. In place of the deterrent the on arm's cities queue a Builder (7 frames), a Campus (5), the capital's Monument (6) and, on one frame, a Trader with a Commercial Hub in a second city.
